changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reviews WHERE booking_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY booking_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: Giữ lại review sớm nhất của mỗi booking trước khi thêm ràng buộc
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM reviews r USING reviews keep WHERE r.booking_id IS NOT NULL AND r.booking_id = keep.booking_id AND (keep.created_at, keep.review_id) < (r.created_at, r.review_id);
